architecture.initialization: Recorded PyTorch defaults, with explicit PAD/UNK zero rows

policy.diagnostic_boundary: After diagnostic updates, reset all seeds and create fresh model, optimizer and shuffle generator before N0 training.

loss.epoch_aggregation: sum of example losses divided by processed example count
loss.name: CrossEntropyLoss

neural_inputs.pad_embedding: zero, excluded from pooling sum and denominator
neural_inputs.unk_embedding: initially zero, trainable; included in pooling denominator
